title: Spacious 4BR Pet-Friendly Home on 30A with a Community Pool
meta_description: Family Affair, a pet-friendly 4BR, 2BA private home on 30A in Santa Rosa Beach with an open floor plan, a deck, Xplorie benefits, and a shared pool. Sleeps 8.

normalized_matching_profile.name: Family Affair
normalized_matching_profile.description: Welcome to your perfect getaway in Santa Rosa Beach! This spacious home comfortably accommodates 8 guests with 4 inviting bedrooms and 2 modern bathrooms. As you step inside, you'll be greeted by the open floor plan, where a cozy living area awaits with plenty of seating and a TV for your entertainment. Adjacent is the dining area, which seats eight with additional seating at the peninsula, perfect for enjoying meals together. The fully equipped kitchen is a chef's dream, featuring all the essentials plus the added convenience of a toaster, coffee maker, and washer and dryer for your laundry needs.When it's time to unwind, step outside to the relaxing deck, complete with comfortable seating, ideal for enjoying the fresh air. The true highlight lies in the fenced backyard, where you'll find a charming seating area and a bonfire spot with four chairs, perfect for gathering around on cool evenings, making memories that will last a lifetime.Plus, you're just a stone's throw away from not one, but two beach accesses! Explore the beauty of Blue Mountain Beach, where sun, sand, and surf await. Don't miss out on this opportunity for an unforgettable vacation—book your stay today!Sleeping Arrangements:Bedroom 1: King bed, tv, private bathroom with dual vanity mirror and walk in shower.Bedroom 2: Queen bed, tv and shared hallway bathroom.Bedroom 3: Queen bed, tv.Bedroom 4: Sofa that pulls out to a queen bed, and a tv.Blue Mountain Beach:The Blue Mountain Beach neighborhood has something for everyone. The local creamery has made its mark on this delightful neighborhood - when you come to Blue Mountain, you have to stop for their homemade ice cream. Just a short drive west and you’re close to all the shopping, restaurants, and entertainment of Sandestin, Miramar Beach and Destin. Go east and you can visit all the popular South Walton beach communities of Grayton Beach, Seagrove, Seaside and more.Your stay at Family Affair comes with Xplorie’s best activities! one ticket per day, per activity! (over $800 in nightly value) Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!* Pet friendly: If bringing a pet, an additional non-refundable pet fee will be added to your booking. Please contact us if you are bringing a dog. A maximum of 2 dogs is allowed at a maximum of 20 lbs. Please see our rental policies for further details.* Please, NO Smoking.* Parking for 2 cars only.* Please note that the garage is reserved for owner use only and will not be accessible to guests.A Benchmark welcome bag and initial starter kit of amenities are provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, and 1 liner for each trashcan. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of soap/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 2 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom, plus 2 washing machine pods.
